item.title: NANCY AXED IN CLEAR-OUT
item.description: CELTIC have sacked Wilfried Nancy after six defeats in eight games and a month in charge at the champions. The axe fell on the 48-year-old Frenchman when his position at the club was viewed as untenable. Nancy’s four weeks are the shortest tenure of any permanent boss in the club’s history.
